EmulateMixSegmentInBuffer: the gain ramp and remaining-frame update from the pseudocode; returns the ramp step (the original result register)
EmulateMixMultipleSegments: decodes A and B through slot 0x34 and C through slot 0x30, mixes each, returns the largest count
MixSegmentInBuffer: remaining-frame skip, gain ramp per frame, unity tail mix; the return value is the last result register the original leaves (callers ignore it)
StopSegment: mode 17 releases the decoding buffer through slot 0x24, then the record is reset to the stopped values

UpdateOldSegmentState: copy of record C into B, play mode 2, the zeroed record for no rule or non-positive frames. Not reproduced: the rule branch with frames (loop-list end lookups and the ramp sums)
UpdateDyingSegmentState: record B copied into A (play mode 3, state 4), gain ramp set over the loop-list headroom of the chunk
UpdateCurrentSegmentState: the index -1 branch and the no-rule tail. Not reproduced: the element and rule branches (slots 0x1c and 0x20 results, element list copy, frame ramp)
SetState(NativeSubDecoderState*): playlist manager SetState (when both sides exist), every saved word, the three records and the elements
GetState(NativeSubDecoderState*): the reverse copy of SetState
MixMultipleSegments: realloc of the 32-bit mixing buffer, decode and mix of A, B, C, then clipping to 16-bit samples; returns the largest decode count

ApplyTransitionRule: kind-1 branch (next-dying test, swap, frame check) and the no-element result. Not reproduced: the playlist element lookup, transpose, previous-state and reset calls, and the copy of the found element
UpdateSegmentsStates: the history shift and the no-element branch. Not reproduced: the element lookup by the two index words, the rule table branch and the peek of the next element
InterpretTransitionRule: not reproduced (rule table and playlist peek are not ported)
SetState(int): stores the index and dispatches on the stored element. Not reproduced: the state-table lookups (field_24_ and states_ containers are not ported)
EmulateDecode: next-event check, one-segment decode through slot 0x34 or the multi-segment emulation, stops in A, B, C order, mode 17 flags
Decode: next-event check, one-segment decode through slot 0x18 or MixMultipleSegments, stops in A, B, C order
